title: GetOverwatchesFullCommand
description: Schema for Service Manager registry retrieval command OM1. This command is sent by the Orchestrator to the Service Manager to request the full list of registered Overwatches, including their associated Sentinels.

type.description: NGSI-LD entity type. It has to be getOverwatchesFullCommand.

originator.description: Property. Component that generated the command.

timestamp.description: Property. Date and time at which the command was generated.
